$comment: Source-pixel spec (1536x1024 → 36x24) — the Purple Line tunnel west from Cubbon Park to Majestic (story 4.6, ADR-158). The tunnel runs right → left: the upper track, the central walkway with its yellow line, the stalled train on the lower track (a block), the lower track under it. The cable-tray walls top and bottom are `buildings`, except the two cross-passages in the bottom wall (the still ones wait in them) and the maintenance alcove in the top wall (its lockers are a block). At the far left, Majestic's platform: the steps up are blocks; the platform edge is where the group's choice plays. You come in out of the dark at the right end of the walkway.
name: purple_tunnel
